positive_snippets:
Our stay at the resort was truly a memorable and refreshing experience from start to finish.
From the warm welcome at check-in to the smooth checkout process, everything was handled with utmost professionalism.
The ambiance of the resort instantly made us feel relaxed and at peace.
The rooms were exceptionally clean, spacious, and beautifully designed with great attention to detail.
The housekeeping team ensured that every corner was perfectly maintained throughout our stay.
The scenic surroundings and serene atmosphere added a magical charm to our vacation.
The food served at the restaurant was absolutely delicious, with a wide variety of options to choose from.
Every meal felt thoughtfully prepared and presented with care.
The staff members were courteous, attentive, and always ready to assist with a smile.
Their hospitality truly made us feel valued and special as guests.
The amenities provided were top-notch and well-maintained.
We particularly enjoyed the leisure facilities, which added so much fun and relaxation to our trip.
The resort perfectly balances luxury and comfort.
It is an ideal destination for both families and couples seeking a peaceful getaway.
The attention to guest satisfaction was evident in every interaction.
We felt safe, comfortable, and completely stress-free during our stay.
The overall experience exceeded our expectations in every way.
It was not just a stay, but a beautiful experience we will cherish for a long time.
We highly appreciate the dedication and effort of the entire team.
We look forward to visiting again and would wholeheartedly recommend this wonderful resort to everyone.

I recently stayed at Eden Group Hotels in Faridabad, and it was a really pleasant experience. The hospitality here truly stands out — the staff are warm, courteous, and always ready to help.

From check-in to room service, everything was handled smoothly and with genuine care.

The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with all the essentials you’d expect .

What impressed me most was the overall atmosphere of warmth and professionalism — it really makes you feel at home.

After such a positive experience in Faridabad, I’m definitely looking forward to visiting other Eden Group properties, especially in Manali and other locations. If the same level of hospitality carries through, I’m sure those stays will be just as memorable.

I came to stay with my family, the farmhouse is well maintained and clean. Everyone had a great time, the owners ensured personalized service and paid attention to detail. The rooms are spacious and relaxing and the swimming pool is cleaner than most farmhouses we have been to. Will recommend the property to anyone travelling with their family or friends for a weekend getaway or small family function (And Dharmendra is so good)
negative_snippets:
One of the worst properties we have ever stayed at. A complete waste of money and peace of mind.

There was no electricity for nearly 6 hours, no hot water, and the snacks were absurdly overpriced — ₹50 for a single cup of tea and ₹30 for a basic water bottle! On top of that, there was zero coordination with customers and we were illegally charged an extra ₹700 without any proper explanation.

We had booked 3 Superior Rooms (double occupancy each) and 1 Family Room (4 occupancy), but instead we were randomly given 4 Superior Rooms, completely changing our booking without consent. To make matters worse, the owner Ms. Fatima actually asked us to shift rooms midway just so she could accommodate new customers. This is completely unprofessional and unacceptable.

Hygiene was a serious issue.
•	No fresh bed sheets
•	No proper blankets
•	Bedsheets and mattresses were sticky and dirty
•	Towels were smelly and unhygienic

The rooms may look decent in pictures, but don’t be fooled — the reality is far from what’s advertised.

Location is another nightmare. Ola and Uber cancel trips repeatedly due to pathetic village roads, and the area feels unsafe, especially for girls and women.

Overall experience: Pathetic management, poor hygiene, false promises, and zero customer respect.
Highly, highly NOT recommended. Avoid at all costs.
